extraction.document_summary: This brochure describes two government-approved ElderShield-enhancement supplements from Singlife: Singlife ElderShield Standard and Singlife ElderShield Plus. Both boost your monthly Severe Disability benefit and pay it monthly for up to 12 years or for life, as long as you remain severely disabled (unable to perform a defined number of ADLs). Standard requires inability to perform at least 3 of 6 ADLs, while Plus requires at least 2 of 6. The payout level is stated as S$600 to S$5,000 monthly, plus a Dependant Care Benefit of S$200 monthly for up to 36 months if you have a child aged 22 and below at claim. Both supplements also include a lump-sum for severe disability (up to three times the first monthly benefit) and a death payout of three times the last monthly benefit if death occurs while receiving monthly/Rehabilitation payouts. Premiums can be paid via MediSave (up to S$600 per calendar year). Premiums are waived while receiving the Severe Disability or Rehabilitation benefits. Standard additionally includes a Rehabilitation Benefit if you recover but are still unable to perform 2 ADLs and need physical assistance throughout, and Standard also notes a premium payment term limited to up to policy anniversary or to age 65 (ANB-based).
quality_notes: Document clearly separates benefits/features for ElderShield Standard vs ElderShield Plus, including ADL threshold differences.
Some eligibility/term details are referenced as footnotes (e.g., “up to 12 years or for life”), but the brochure states the key mechanics in the main sections.
Quantitative plan options (e.g., S$300/S$400 ElderShield basic scheme) are mentioned for context, but no standalone new-customer premium/age limits for the Singlife supplements are explicitly given.

Several important clauses are in “Important notes” but are not expressed with complete legal precision (e.g., MediSave cap, premium payment term constraint), so values are extracted only where explicitly stated.

policies.quick_summary: Singlife ElderShield Standard is a Singlife ElderShield supplement that enhances the government ElderShield scheme by paying an additional monthly benefit for severe disability (S$600 to S$5,000 monthly) for up to 12 years or for life, when you are severely disabled and unable to perform at least 3 of 6 ADLs. It can also pay a lump-sum for severe disability (up to three times the first monthly benefit) and a death payout equal to three times the last monthly benefit if death occurs while receiving benefits. Standard includes a Rehabilitation Benefit after recovery from severe disability—if you are still unable to perform 2 ADLs (even with special aids) and need physical assistance—payable for the remaining benefit payout duration. A Dependant Care Benefit adds S$200 monthly for up to 36 months for eligible children. Premiums can be paid using MediSave (up to S$600 per calendar year) and are waived while receiving the Severe Disability or Rehabilitation benefits.
coverage_scope: Additional monthly Severe Disability benefit under the ElderShield scheme (S$600 to S$5,000 monthly)
Lump-sum payout for severe disability (up to three times first monthly benefit)
Rehabilitation Benefit after severe disability recovery (Standard only)
Dependant Care Benefit (S$200 monthly; child aged 22 and below at point of claim; up to 36 months)
Death payout while receiving monthly/Rehabilitation benefit (three times last monthly benefit)
Waiver of premium payment while receiving Severe Disability or Rehabilitation benefits
MediSave payment option for annual premiums (up to S$600 per calendar year, per life assured)
policies.eligibility_notes: Must have a basic ElderShield policy before purchase. Severe disability definition: unable to perform at least three of six ADLs.
policies.coverage_term_description: Monthly Severe Disability benefit is payable for up to 12 years or for life, if you are severely disabled and unable to perform at least 3 of the 6 ADLs.
policies.premium_payment_term_description: Choose a premium payment period: pay for life, or pay for 20 years or up to your 65th birthday (66 age next birthday) – whichever is later—however the 65th-birthday option is only stated as available with Singlife ElderShield Standard.
important_caveats: Severe disability threshold differs between Standard and Plus: Standard requires inability to perform at least 3 of 6 ADLs.

Rehabilitation Benefit is payable only for Standard and only when the Life Assured recovers from severe disability but still cannot perform 2 out of 6 ADLs (even with special aids) and requires physical assistance throughout the activities.
Premium waiver applies while receiving either the Severe Disability Beneﬁt or the Rehabilitation Benefit.
MediSave use is limited to up to S$600 per calendar year, per life assured; premiums exceeding this limit must be paid in cash.

review_notes: Brochure presents both Standard and Plus in the same document; extracted only Singlife ElderShield Standard as the requested standalone base product.
No explicit underwriting method, entry age limits, or policy expiry/maturity age for Standard are stated in the provided text; those fields are left null/not_stated.

Basic ElderShield payout (ElderShield 300/400) is referenced only for context and not modeled as separate policies/benefits beyond stating that the Singlife benefit enhances it; only Singlife-stated payout mechanics are extracted into benefits.
